description: This file defines the RemoteInsertionActivity class, which manages media insertion requests via intents, handles activity lifecycle events, and communicates media data back through broadcasts.

classes.name: RemoteInsertionActivity
classes.description: An activity that handles media insertion requests, initiates media picking intents, and broadcasts the selected media URI back to the requester.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves request data from intent or saved state, and initiates media picking if first creation.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves activity state including request IDs and MIME types.

methods.name: doPickIntent
methods.description: Creates and starts an intent to pick an image from media store.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the media pick activity, broadcasts the media URI if successful, and finishes the activity.
